script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. SLEEK LABORATORY - NIGHT

A hush falls over the room as DR. HANNAH SILVA (30s, brilliant, dedicated) addresses her team.

DR. SILVA
(passionately)
We're on the precipice of history, folks. In three days, we'll unveil the world's first Artificially Intelligent coach, and change the game of basketball forever.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY 3

The team gathers around the AI COACH, a sleek black box. A holographic screen flickers to life.

AI COACH (voiceover)
(calmly)
Initiating boot sequence.

The room buzzes with excitement.

INT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY 1

Team STRIKE, led by CAPTAIN JOSH HENDERSON (20s, talented, driven), practices with the new AI coach.

AI COACH (voiceover)
(analyzing)
Josh, your form is off. Try bending your knees more.

Josh, surprised, adjusts his stance.

CAPTAIN JOSH HENDERSON
(confused)
How did you know that?

AI COACH (voiceover)
I've analyzed your stats and your team's performance. I've learned from the best coaches in history. I'll make you all better.

INT. SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - NIGHT

Team STRIKE faces OFF against RIVAL TEAM, led by ALL-STAR POINT GUARD, TYRONE JONES (20s, arrogant, skilled).

AI COACH (voiceover)
(analyzing)
Tyrones' weakness is his overconfidence. We'll exploit it.

Team Strike scores a surprising win, leaving Tyrones stunned.

INT. MEDIA CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY 14

The media questions DR. SILVA about the ethical implications of an AI coach.

DR. SILVA
(seriously)
Artificial Intelligence is a tool, not a replacement for human coaches. It's meant to enhance their abilities, not replace them.

INT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY 21

Team Strike faces a tough match against INDUSTRIAL UNION, led by their human coach, COACH MILLS (50s, experienced, cunning).

AI COACH (voiceover)
(analyzing)
Coach Mills relies on psychology. We'll counter with a surprise play.

Team Strike executes the new play, leaving Coach Mills baffled.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

The team gathers around the AI coach, who looks worried.

AI COACH (voiceover)
(anxiously)
I've discovered a flaw in my programming. If I'm forced to make a decision in a situation I haven't been trained on, I'll make a mistake.

DR. SILVA
(confidently)
We'll fix it. We'll train you on every possible scenario.

INT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY 30

Team Strike faces their biggest challenge yet, against the INTERNATIONAL ALL-STARS, led by LEGENDARY COACH, KAREN O'MALLEY (40s, intimidating, legendary).

AI COACH (voiceover)
(analyzing)
Karen's strategy is unpredictable. We'll need to adapt.

Team Strike manages to keep up with the All-Stars, but the AI coach falters when faced with an unforeseen situation.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

The team works tirelessly to upgrade the AI coach, and soon it's ready for its next challenge.

INT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY 45

Team Strike faces the All-Stars again, and this time, the AI coach outmaneuvers Karen, leading the team to a resounding victory.

INT. PRESIDENTIAL PALACE - DAY 50

President KENDRICK welcomes Team Strike and the AI coach into the White House.

PRESIDENT KENDRICK
Your achievements have shown the world what's possible when we embrace technology and innovation.

AI COACH (voiceover)
(gratefully)
Thank you, President Kendrick. I'm just a tool, but I hope to continue inspiring greatness.

FADE OUT.
